commuter: Use case: style-transfer. Production game sprite atlas, not a concept sheet. Reference image is ONLY the established FedUp driver's illustration style: match compact chibi proportions, bold clean black contour, flat colors and cel shading, simple expressive face, rounded hands and detailed chunky footwear. NEW civilian character: adult Black woman with natural dark curly bun, warm brown skin, teal cropped commuter jacket over cream shirt, dark indigo jeans, white sneakers with orange soles. No FedUp uniform or logos. Friendly everyday Cleveland commuter. True transparent RGBA background, no shadows, gradients, text, labels, borders or panels. EXACT GRID SIX COLUMNS TEN ROWS on a tall 1536x2560 canvas; 60 separate complete full-body drawings, centered in equal cells with clear transparent margins. All poses same body scale and ground baseline; do not crop hair or feet. Rows1-2: 12-frame walk FRONT, rows3-4: 12-frame walk BACK, rows5-6: 12-frame walk LEFT profile, rows7-8: 12-frame walk RIGHT profile. Each pair is chronological left-to-right across first then second row. True articulated alternating gait: frames1 heel contact left foot,2 weight transfer,3 close-feet passing right knee bent,4 right foot swing,5 right extension,6 right heel contact; frames7-12 opposite-foot half with arms exchanging swing. Include close-feet passing poses, not repeated split legs. No view-angle changes within each cycle, no whole-body tilting or fake animation. Row9 columns1-4 are surprise FRONT/BACK/LEFT/RIGHT; columns5-6 are safely tucked comical tumble FRONT/BACK. Row10 columns1-2 are tucked tumble LEFT/RIGHT; columns3-6 are recovering crouch FRONT/BACK/LEFT/RIGHT. Cartoon surprise and recovery have no injury, gore or distress. Maintain character identity, consistent drawing size, clothing and shoe details across all 60. Deliver polished finished in-game art matching reference.
